logistics.format: Online multiple-choice (passing score 70/100). Up to 3 attempts.

recommended_certs.rationale: IAPP の CIPP-E と組み合わせ、ID 領域 + EU プライバシ法務領域でカバレッジを広げる。

plus.note: Combines IAM auditing perspective with privacy lens.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, foundational: 2. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded identity-audit and privacy combination offers entry domain knowledge; no experience requirement, limited recognition and repeated multiple-choice attempts do not establish independent audit capability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The identity-audit and privacy perspective supplies focused entry knowledge at an accessible price. With zero experience, multiple-choice-only assessment and limited independent recognition, the record does not establish applied auditor competence.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded combination of identity auditing and privacy gives this a focused practitioner-domain scope. Open entry and multiple-choice assessment limit the signal to associate knowledge rather than independent audit delivery.
